# Reviewed exceptions to the wire gate. Each line: role wire kind path reason.
# role is fake (the fake emits what the recording lacks) or parser (the parser
# reads what the recording lacks). A path ending in + covers every path that
# starts with the text before it. A path of * covers the whole kind. The gate
# fails on a line that no check needs.
parser responses response.failed|error * the Responses failed frame comes mid-stream, and no request provokes one on demand
parser claudecode * local_command the CLI prints a local command only for a slash command that runs in the terminal; headless runs refuse them
parser claudecode * compact_metadata+ the CLI compacts only after a long conversation, and headless /compact is refused
parser claudecode * status the CLI prints a status frame only while it compacts, and compaction follows a long conversation
parser claudecode * compact_result the CLI prints a compact result only when a compaction ends, and compaction follows a long conversation
parser claudecode * rate_limit_info.overageResetsAt the CLI sends it only while overage is active
parser anthropic content_block_start content_block.data only a redacted thinking block carries data, and no request provokes one
parser chat chunk error+ OpenAI-compatible gateways such as OpenRouter send a mid-stream error object; OpenAI itself does not
parser chat chunk choices[].delta.reasoning+ gateways send reasoning in reasoning, reasoning_content, or reasoning_details; OpenAI chat completions has none
fake chat chunk choices[].delta.reasoning_content a gateway such as Bifrost sends reasoning_content; OpenAI chat completions has no reasoning field
fake claudecode assistant:text parent_tool_use_id the CLI sets it inside a subagent; the harness disallows the Agent tool, so no cheap recording holds one
fake claudecode assistant:tool_use parent_tool_use_id the CLI sets it inside a subagent; the harness disallows the Agent tool, so no cheap recording holds one
fake claudecode user:tool_result parent_tool_use_id the CLI sets it inside a subagent; the harness disallows the Agent tool, so no cheap recording holds one
fake claudecode rate_limit_event rate_limit_info.overageResetsAt the CLI sends it only while overage is active
fake claudecode result/success local_command the CLI prints a local command only for a slash command that runs in the terminal; headless runs refuse them
fake claudecode system/compact_boundary * compaction follows a long conversation, and the headless CLI refuses /compact
fake claudecode system/status * compaction follows a long conversation, and the headless CLI refuses /compact
fake claudecode user:string * the compaction summary is a user frame with text content; headless runs refuse /compact
fake claudecode system/hook_started * the recording runs without hooks; a configured hook prints this frame
fake claudecode system/task_notification * a background task prints this frame, and the recording starts none
